A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same TAViS research work. All ten pages in each version support comparison of text, equations, figures, tables, and references. Neither supplied PDF contains an appendix.

before.justification: v1 reports original TAViS benchmark results, component ablations, qualitative analyses, and zero-shot evaluation in Section 4, Tables 1–6, and Figures 4–5.

after.justification: v2 retains the original TAViS experiments and outcomes in Section 4, Tables 1–6, and Figures 4–5.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same ImageBind/SAM2 architecture, query decomposition, text-bridged hybrid prompting, alignment losses, and overall training objective. The inference procedures are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same single-source S4, multiple-source MS3, semantic AVSS, and AVSBench-OV zero-shot coverage. No dataset, task, or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in Tables 3, 5, and 6 and Figure 5, including the SAMA-AVS comparisons and the OV-AVSS zero-shot baseline.

E3.justification: Sections 4.1–4.5 retain the same metrics, annotation protocols, 224/1024 input resolutions, model configurations, training budgets, and seen/unseen-class evaluation procedure.

E4.justification: The component, alignment-loss, and prompting ablations in Tables 1, 2, and 4 are identical. The backbone controls, t-SNE analysis, and qualitative examples in Table 5 and Figures 4–5 are also retained.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without seed counts, repeated-run uncertainty, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No statistical reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: All results in Tables 1–6 and Figures 4–5 are unchanged. For example, Table 3 retains TAViS's 224-resolution S4/MS3 scores of 84.8/68.2, and Table 6 retains zero-shot scores of 28.21 for TAViS and 22.20 for OV-AVSS.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–7 are unchanged. Neither version includes additional theorems, proofs, or formal assumptions.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contribution list, and conclusion retain identical claims about coupling foundation models through text, improved AVS performance, and zero-shot generalization.

C2.justification: Interpretations concerning modality-specific noise, text-prediction overfitting, resolution effects, and generalization are unchanged. Table 3 retains the same computational limitation explaining omitted 1024-resolution AVSS results.

D1.justification: Section 4.2 retains identical freezing/fine-tuning choices, optimizer, learning rate, batch sizes, and epoch budgets. No implementation or code/data-access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The related-work discussion and all 48 reference entries are unchanged, including positioning relative to prior foundation-model combinations and text-based alignment methods.

P1.justification: The first-page margin stamp changes from v1, dated 13 June 2025, to v2, dated 10 December 2025. The title, authors, prose, terminology, and section structure otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1–5 and Tables 1–6 retain the same graphical content, captions, organization, and placement. The page layout is unchanged apart from negligible rendering differences.

improvement.justification: v2 retains the same scientific content, experimental evidence, explanations, limitations, and reproducibility information as v1. The administrative version/date update produces no meaningful improvement or deterioration in paper quality.
